parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the two switch buttons of the wall switch, made of ABS plastic, rectangular in shape, and designed to be pressed by the user.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator for turning electrical circuits on or off, controlling the flow of electricity to connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pivoting or pressing inward and outward, returning to its neutral position via an internal spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second switch button of the wall switch, also made of ABS plastic, similar in size and shape to the first switch.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional control point, allowing the user to operate a separate electrical circuit or device.
parts.Movement_description: It moves similarly to the first switch, pressing inward to make or break an electrical connection.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate plastic, providing structural support for the switches.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanisms in place and mounts the entire assembly to the wall, ensuring electrical safety and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
